bagPolicy.summary: Leave any bag, purse, backpack or container larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches at home. All bags may be inspected.
allowed: Bags 12 x 6 x 12 inches or smaller
prohibited: Bags, purses, backpacks or containers larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches
bagPolicy.quote: We ask that you leave any bags, purses, backpacks, boxes, containers, etc. of any kind larger than 12” x 6” x 12” at home.

parking.summary: Off Broadway has street parking only. Don't park on President Street, in the gas station lot or in the Lemp Brewery lot.
parking.quote: Please do NOT park on President Street, the gas station lot, or in the Lemp Brewery parking lot.

rideshare.summary: Off Broadway encourages ridesharing when possible, since parking is street only. Set your pickup to 3509 Lemp Avenue.

concessions.summary: Outside drinks aren't allowed, but you can bring outside food to eat on the patio. The bar takes cash, credit and debit, including Visa, Mastercard, Amex and Apple Pay, and there's no ATM.
concessions.quote: we do allow outside food to be brought in and consumed on our patio.

accessibility.summary: Most shows are general admission with no main floor seats, but balcony seating is first come, first served, and there's a large outdoor patio if you need a break. Off Broadway will accommodate guests with disabilities, so contact the venue before your show about seating or other needs.
accessibility.quote: We will always accommodate guests with disabilities in any way we can,

reEntry.summary: Off Broadway hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Buy tickets online at offbroadwaystl.com or at the box office. You can register for will call at the venue during operating hours. Minors under 18 must be with an adult 21 or older.
ticketPickup.quote: you may register for Will Call at the venue during operating hours.

gates.summary: Please don't arrive long before doors open. Door and show times are listed on the Off Broadway homepage for each show.
gates.quote: We ask that guests please do not arrive significantly before doors open.
